name: kb-engine
description: Feed your own knowledge Engine from Claude: a mechanical ingest skill that copies new Gmail threads, Drive files, Fireflies meetings and Calendar events into your Engine unchanged, and a setup skill that schedules one ingest task per source on the smallest model. Curation happens on the Engine, not in Claude.

engine_url.title: Your Knowledge Base Engine address (ends in /mcp)
engine_url.description: Paste the connector address from your Engine's sign-in setup page or its Health screen. Example: https://kb.example.com/mcp. Replace the whole box, including any ${...} text already in it.
